description: Defines types, enums, structs, constants, and function prototypes for the Starboard DRM (Digital Rights Management) module, supporting DRM session management, key status, encryption schemes, and callbacks for media content protection.

methods.name: SbDrmCreateSystem
methods.description: Creates a new DRM system instance with specified key system and callback functions.

methods.name: SbDrmGenerateSessionUpdateRequest
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a session update request payload for given initialization data and type.

methods.name: SbDrmUpdateSession
methods.description: Updates a DRM session with license key data received from the license server.

methods.name: SbDrmCloseSession
methods.description: Closes and clears resources for a specified DRM session.

methods.name: SbDrmUpdateServerCertificate
methods.description: Updates the server certificate for the DRM system.

methods.name: SbDrmGetMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves metrics data from the DRM system, if supported.

methods.name: SbDrmDestroySystem
methods.description: Destroys the DRM system instance, cleaning up resources.
